description: Use this to find clothes to put on a character: the user's own wardrobe items, the ones they saved and the free BudgetPixel library (dresses, suits, sportswear, costumes ...). To dress a character, write both @handles in the prompt of generate_image or generate_video, e.g. "@barry wearing @camel_coat_set at a gala": the item's picture goes with it and the person wears it. q filters by words ("red dress", "winter"); category by shelf (work, party, sport, swim, underwear ...); source narrows to mine, saved or house. fit is who the clothes are cut for: pass the character's gender (from list_characters or get_character: female or male) to get what suits them, unisex clothes included. Every item says its fit. Free.

category.description: Optional: one shelf. cosplay = anime and game characters' outfits (search q for the character or franchise, e.g. "naruto"); influencers = the AI influencers' signature outfits.

fit.description: Optional: who the clothes are cut for. Pass the character's gender (female or male) to get the clothes that suit them, unisex ones included; unisex returns unisex only.

q.description: Optional words that must all appear in the item's name, description or tags, e.g. "red dress" or "winter".

source.description: Optional: mine (the user's own), saved, house (the free library), or all (default).

name: search_wardrobe
title: Search Wardrobe
